replay.note: Month-end total-return data (Ken French CRSP market), so intra-month extremes such as Oct 1987 and Mar 2020 are understated. Dials are as known at each month end.

rules.rule: Drawdown >= 10% and credit spreads past peak
Drawdown >= 15% and credit spreads past peak
Drawdown >= 20% and credit spreads past peak
Drawdown >= 25% and credit spreads past peak
Drawdown >= 30% and credit spreads past peak

deployments.rule: Staged: a third of the reserve at -10%, -20%, -30%

buy_timing.note: Rules chosen on 1960-1999 only (best 24-month edge with >= 5 independent triggers); 2000-2026 is out of sample. Triggers are de-duplicated to one per 12 months.
